description: Enhanced secured ingress route config: a minimal config (status off, no virtual cluster, no public admin, no secured paths, retries disabled) yielding only the catch-all local route; status virtual clusters with one enabled per-method retry but no admin access; and public admin access with two secured sub-paths and the default retry disabled.

cases.expected_output:
routeConfigName=ingress_secured_routes
vhost.name=secured_local_service
vhost.domains=[*]
vhost.virtualClusters=[]
vhost.retryPolicy.retryOn=
vhost.retryPolicy.numRetries=0
routes=1
route[0] prefix=/ method=[] cluster=local_service retry=false

routeConfigName=ingress_secured_routes
vhost.name=secured_local_service
vhost.domains=[*]
vhost.virtualClusters=[status,endpoints]
vhost.retryPolicy.retryOn=reset,connection-failure
vhost.retryPolicy.numRetries=2
routes=2
route[0] prefix=/ method=[GET] cluster=local_service retry=true
